question: Should memory-lancedb permanently expose all three auto-recall tuning controls as independent advanced plugin settings?
rationale: Repository policy sets a high bar for new configuration, and code review cannot determine whether operators should independently control threshold, candidate count, and prompt injection cap or whether a narrower policy surface is preferred.

options.title: Approve three advanced settings
options.body: Accept the proposed plugin-owned controls after fixing integer schema validation, rebasing, and adding real runtime proof.

options.title: Narrow the tuning surface
options.body: Expose only the operator-facing selectivity control maintainers want and derive the internal candidate and cap values.

options.title: Keep current defaults
options.body: Decline additional configuration until concrete operational cases show the fixed policy is insufficient.

recommendation.title: Approve three advanced settings
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed plugin-owned controls after fixing integer schema validation, rebasing, and adding real runtime proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work owns the adjacent auto-recall and auto-capture behavior most directly affected by this product choice.
